data: Four fixed public synthetic utterances; no personal audio/transcripts. Identical fixture inputs/history and primary outputs across 24 pairs.
scope: Mac loopback WebSocket, own inference workers, existing development services left running; external GPU load not controlled.

definitions.cold: first session turn only; different first fixture for each cache setting, matched before/after
definitions.textToFirstWavMs: receive final ASR text to receive WAV on Mac loopback
definitions.finishToFirstWavMs: send finish to receive first WAV on Mac loopback
definitions.estimatedEnergyToFirstWavMs: last endpoint energy estimate to first WAV; not human end of speech
definitions.captureToListeningMs: start message to server listening acknowledgement; not Android microphone readiness
definitions.status: technical completion and normalised synthetic reference match; not linguistic/human validation
definitions.sourceAudio: same voiced fixture bytes; trailing captured silence varies with endpoint scheduling

reply.japanese: ホットのコーヒー一つですね。
reply.romaji: Hotto no kōhī hitotsu desu ne.

reply.japanese: 京都までですね。片道ですか、往復ですか？
reply.romaji: Kyōto made desu ne. Katamichi desu ka, ōfuku desu ka?
reply.french: Pour Kyoto, d’accord. Aller simple ou aller-retour ?

reply.japanese: フランスはとても素敵な国ですね。どんなところが好きですか？
reply.romaji: Furansu wa totemo suteki na kuni desu ne. Donna tokoro ga suki desu ka?

reply.japanese: 日本語を毎日勉強しますか？
reply.romaji: Nihongo o mainichi benkyō shimasu ka?
reply.french: Étudies-tu le japonais tous les jours ?

ee89fb0de5d7.coaching: Mainichi veut dire tous les jours ; benkyō shimasu veut dire étudier. Tu peux répondre hai ou iie.
